children: was on track to extend its gains to a seventh straight session on Wednesday, with shares up 2.48% to $81.25.
The stock has been on an upward trajectory since October 6, when it closed 0.71% higher at $71.39. On October 8, it jumped 5.11% to $75.14, bumping the stock further.
, ETSY added nearly 11%, compared to a flat S&P500 index.
, ETSY has been rated Buy with a score of 3.91 out of 5. The company has been graded A for momentum but is dragged down by a D grade for valuation.
Both Seeking Alpha and Wall Street analysts also echoed similar sentiments and issued a Buy call for the stock.
In an article last month, Seeking Alpha analyst
assigned a Buy rating, bullish on the firm’s AI opportunities.

“AI could turn Etsy's discovery challenge into a competitive advantage, matching shoppers' intentions with distinctive products while external shopping agents create new paths into the marketplace,” the analyst argued.

“Gifting and life events can increase purchase occasions. And more frequently purchased, Etsy-native categories can increase habitual traffic. None of these require Etsy to become something fundamentally different. In fact, I think the opportunity is precisely the opposite. Technology can allow Etsy to become better at being Etsy,” he further added.

title: Etsy on track to widen gains to seventh straight session
